description:
Aggregate the work that makes archive preview, candidate listing and snapshot export read the same captured image as the operations they describe.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Archive preview and candidate listing run the execute planner in one read-only session, the previewed plan equals the executed plan over the same image, and the storage-only archive planning helpers are gone.
- [hard] REQ-02: Container-destination evidence is requested by one function, and the container marker name is declared once.
- [hard] REQ-03: Archive planning resolves each artifact reference once per plan and computes reachability once per distinct document root.
- [hard] REQ-04: Snapshot export writes the stored bytes of each issue and of every declaration file the repository layout defines, read from one captured image.
title: Archive planning and snapshot export read through the execute session
